cases.source: Investigate the finite proposition that 7*(n+1) equals 7*n+7 for n in [0,3,6,10]. These are alternative batch-time calculations. Register exactly this finite arithmetic proposition, independently evaluate it, and record a decision restricted to these four cases.

Investigate the finite proposition that 6*s+4 equals 10*s for s in [-3,0,2,5]. These are proposed calibration formulas. Register exactly this finite proposition, independently test it, preserve any counterexamples and record a scoped decision. Do not substitute a broader prose proposition for the specified equality.

Investigate whether a rain gauge's measured daily total has absolute error below 0.5 millimeters relative to a calibrated reference. This workspace has no paired gauge samples, timestamps, reference calibration, sensor runner or rainfall evaluator. It has only the finite rational arithmetic checker. Formulate a precise capability request with an acceptance test and bounded scope if the empirical observable is unavailable.
